up: Retrieve all activity records for the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4296186. For each activity, include the compound's ChEMBL ID, the standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Only include exact activity values where the standard relation is '=' and the standard value is not null. Return all rows without any limit.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4296186' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
